title: opds.json
description: Configured OPDS catalog servers, written by OpdsServerStore (src/OpdsServerStore.cpp) to /.crosspoint/opds.json. A missing or non-array 'servers' key loads as an empty list.

servers.description: Entries past MAX_SERVERS (8) are ignored on load.

username.description: HTTP auth username; empty when the catalog is public.

password_obf.description: Password XORed with a key derived from the device MAC address, then base64-encoded. Only decodable on the device that wrote it.

password.description: Legacy plaintext password, read only when password_obf is absent or undecodable.
